about_the_game:
Written in the Foreword: This game is entirely developed by an independent individual. Due to my inability to achieve perfect data balance, I have modified various publicly available data from POE to create the game's data system. As a tribute to POE and to make the source of data balance transparent, I have retained POE's naming conventions without concealment. I hope you all enjoy the game.

The Realm of Reincarnation This game is centered around: slaying monsters, farming gear, leveling up, random talents, upgrading equipment, acquiring top-tier drops, and experiencing endless loot-driven excitement.

Break free from class restrictions, create your own unique playstyle. With over 1,000 random talents, even enemies will gain randomized talents, ensuring every run feels different. Explore unknown maps, challenge hidden paths—each route offers a unique experience. Through endless reincarnation trials, carve out your own world.

Core Gameplay: Highly randomized elements, including equipment, skills. Diverse monsters and maps.

Tree of Map Exploration:

Discover Unknown Paths, Every time you enter the game, you will generate a new map route with different probabilities. There are diverse worlds waiting for you to explore. Whether it's farming monsters or gear, you will continuously experience the thrill of loot drops for a long time.

Random Talents:

Randomly Draw Talents, Enemies will also randomly acquire the talents you abandon. If you're not careful, the talents you discard might end up strengthening your enemies, making your battles even more painful!

Active and Support Skills:

Centered Around a Single Skill Release, but this skill can be linked with different support skill gems to achieve extraordinary effects.

Skills Must Be Inserted into Equipment Slots. Support skills link to active skills, enhancing their effects.

Active Skills Determine the Type of Ability. Support gems only work when matched with a compatible active skill.

Equipment:

There are a lot of rare equipment with skill holes. The higher the rarity, the more guaranteed affixes. The same level of equipment has different combinations, and the random space is larger.

content_descriptors.notes: includes fantasy violence, use of alcohol, and mild partial nudity.
